# Save My Exams

> Comprehensive exam preparation platform providing revision notes, past papers, and study resources for IB Diploma Programme, A-Level, and AP qualifications.

Save My Exams specializes in structured revision materials for the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IB DP), including the Core components (Theory of Knowledge, CAS, Extended Essay) and subject-specific resources across multiple exam boards including Edexcel, AQA, and College Board.

## Key Topics

- IB Diploma Programme
- International Baccalaureate
- Theory of Knowledge (TOK)
- Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS)
- Extended Essay
- IB Core
- Environmental Systems & Societies (ESS)
- IB Global Politics
- A-Level
- Exam Preparation
- Revision Notes
- Past Papers
- Edexcel
- AQA
- College Board

## IB Diploma Programme

- [IB Revision Notes, Past Papers & Exam Questions](https://www.savemyexams.com/dp): Complete IB Diploma Programme revision hub with notes, papers & flashcards
- [IB Core Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/dp/core): IB Diploma Programme Core resources: notes, questions & papers for TOK/CAS/EE
- [IB Core Revision Notes | Quick, Easy, and Effective Study](https://www.savemyexams.com/dp/core/revision-notes): Structured IB Core study notes for TOK, CAS & Extended Essay topics

## IB Core Components

- [Core Revision Resources](https://www.savemyexams.com/subjects/core): IB DP Core revision hub covering Theory of Knowledge, CAS & Extended Essay
- [Core Revision Notes](https://www.savemyexams.com/subjects/core/revision-notes): IB DP Core revision notes for CAS, Extended Essay & Theory of Knowledge

## IB Subject Resources

- [Environmental Systems & Societies (ESS) Revision Resources](https://www.savemyexams.com/subjects/environmental-systems-and-societies-ess): IB DP Environmental Systems & Societies exam prep and study resources
